title: Syndicate
description: A model provider in the agency inventory: one endpoint, one transport, and one or more dispatchable channels. Substations host syndicates; syndicates serve channels; channels grade out to capabilities.

id.description: Unique syndicate identifier, assigned by the datastore

slug.description: Dispatch address. `dispatch.provider` in etc/agency.json names this; `slug:channel_slug` addresses one channel directly.

description.description: What this syndicate is and why it is in the inventory

vendor.description: Organization behind the models (anthropic, ollama, openai, self)

transport_slug.description: Reference into the transport table - selects the provider handler and the capability ceiling

endpoint.description: Where the syndicate answers. HTTP transports need base_uri; subprocess transports need command.

base_uri.description: Scheme://host[:port] with no trailing path - the transport's default_path is appended

path.description: Overrides the transport's default_path when a deployment differs

credential_id.description: Vault credential holding the bearer token or API key. Null when auth_mode is none or inherited - secrets never live in this record.

substation_id.description: The substation hosting this syndicate, when the host is also under agency inventory

egress.description: Where prompt content travels. local: this host only. private: operator-controlled network (tailnet/LAN). public: a third party's infrastructure. Disclosed in every briefing; gated by dispatch.egress_policy.

verify_tls.description: Verify TLS certificates on HTTP transports

channels.description: Dispatchable model channels served by this syndicate. A substation may host one syndicate serving many channels.

model.description: Model identifier as the endpoint expects it

default.description: Channel used when the syndicate is addressed without one

capabilities.description: Capability slugs this channel grants. Must be dependency-closed and within the transport ceiling.

max_concurrent.description: Parallel requests this channel tolerates. A workstation serving a 30B model is not a fleet - the dispatcher clamps mission concurrency to this.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-task ceiling; overrides the mission timeout when lower

parameters.description: Inference parameters passed through to the endpoint

cost.description: Dispatch economics - what routing here actually costs the operator

class.description: free: no marginal cost. amortized: owned hardware, cost is electricity. metered: billed per token.

harness_profile.description: Harness profile the agency runs this channel under (functions, commands, loop limits). Null: every harness function the channel's capabilities grant, under the etc/agency.json harness limits. Meaningful only when the channel grants tool_use.

notes.description: Operator notes - suitability, quirks, observed behavior

status.description: Reachability state, refreshed by `nim.agency syndicate probe` (and conformance, by `syndicate conform`) - observed, not composed

models_reported.description: Models the endpoint advertised at last probe - drift from `channels` means the inventory is stale

conformance.description: Known-answer suite results by channel slug, refreshed by `nim.agency syndicate conform`. Reachability says the endpoint answers; conformance says how often it answers correctly.

enabled.description: Operator kill switch - a disabled syndicate is refused at the briefing
